title: Perspective discovery phase result (paper-research fixture, perspectives.md)
description: Validates the structured result object the perspective-discovery phase returns alongside its perspectives.md artifact. artifactPath must equal the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml (the core's runtime enforces the same exact match); perspectives are required because distinct perspectives are the phase's whole product.

artifactPath.description: Exactly the artifact name the phase declares in team.yml; the runtime writes the reply body there and rejects any other value.

summary.description: Structured Chinese summary of perspectives.md: the discovered perspectives and the coverage self-assessment.

openQuestions.description: Questions the scouting noticed but did not expand; mirrors the phase result contract's optional openQuestions field.
